text: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Melbourne for operational reporting and data warehousing?

result.keyword: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Melbourne for operational reporting and data warehousing?

items.markdown:
When looking for top-tier consultants in Melbourne specialising in **Microsoft Power BI**, **Microsoft Fabric** , and modern **data warehousing/operational reporting**, `a mix of specialized boutique data consultancies and major enterprise transformation partners` stand out.

The leading providers in the Melbourne market equipped for end-to-end data estate modernization, lakehouse architecture (Fabric), and high-performance operational dashboards include:

- **[InfoCentric](http://www.infocentric.com.au/)** – Headquartered on Collins Street, Melbourne, InfoCentric is widely recognized as a premier data and analytics consultancy in Australia. They have a heavy focus on enterprise data warehousing, Azure Synapse, and modern Microsoft Fabric implementations, alongside advanced Power BI semantic modeling and governance. They excel at complex operational reporting transformations for large enterprise and government bodies.[[1]](https://au.linkedin.com/in/pratdwiv)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEhCaVl6TTJOZxgK)
- **[Antares Solutions](https://antares.solutions/data-analytics-microsoft-fabric/advanced-analytics-and-power-bi/)** – A prominent Microsoft Solutions Partner with specialized accreditation for Analytics on Microsoft Azure. Antares has a strong Melbourne footprint and provides strategy-led implementations spanning Microsoft Fabric, enterprise data warehousing, and real-time operational Power BI dashboards. They are particularly well-regarded for mid-to-large commercial and not-for-profit/government deployments.[[1]](https://antares.solutions/data-analytics-microsoft-fabric/advanced-analytics-and-power-bi/)
- **Deloitte Australia (Melbourne Practice)** – For large-scale enterprise transformations, Deloitte operates one of the country's largest data and analytics practices out of Melbourne. They specialize in aligning operational metrics with strategic executive reporting, bridging the gap between underlying Microsoft Fabric/Azure data architectures and boardroom-ready Power BI visual frameworks.
- **Boutique & Specialized Providers (e.g., Infonyx and regional Microsoft User Group-linked specialists)** – Melbourne has a vibrant ecosystem of specialized Microsoft data boutiques (such as **Infonyx** on St Kilda Road) and independent practitioners active in the Melbourne Power BI User Group who provide rapid, highly tailored operational dashboard creation and DAX optimization.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdNMWN6YzBNV2htGAo)

To help narrow down which consultant or firm is the best fit for your specific project, feel free to share:

- **The approximate scale of your data** (e.g., number of data sources, volume, and current database platforms)
- **Whether you are transitioning** from legacy systems (like SQL Server, Tableau, or Qlik) or starting fresh on Microsoft Fabric
- **Your primary operational reporting goals** (e.g., real-time tracking, automated budgeting, or supply chain visibility)

I can provide a more tailored recommendation based on **project scope** and **team size**.
